profile.title: Profile Settings

admin.title: Administrator Guide
admin.description: Full system access and configuration control.

system_management.title: System Management
system_management.content: As an Admin, you have full control over the Nexa system. You can manage all projects, users, and system-wide settings. You are responsible for maintaining the integrity and security of the platform.

user_management.title: User Management
user_management.content: You can create, update, and deactivate user accounts. You assign roles (Admin, Team Leader, Tester) to users, determining their access levels.

project_oversight.title: Project Oversight
project_oversight.content: You can view and edit any project in the system, regardless of membership. You can create new projects and archive old ones.

project_management.title: Project Management
project_management.content: You can create and manage projects. Within your projects, you can invite members, set up test suites, and define milestones.

test_planning.title: Test Planning
test_planning.content: You are responsible for creating Test Plans and Test Runs. You assign test cases to Testers and track the overall progress of testing cycles.

review_approval.title: Review & Approval
review_approval.content: You review test cases created by Testers. You can approve them for execution or request changes. You also have the final say on test run completion.

test_execution.title: Test Execution
test_execution.content: Your primary role is to execute assigned test runs. You will mark test cases as Pass/Fail, report bugs, and attach evidence (screenshots/logs).

test_case_creation.title: Test Case Creation
test_case_creation.content: You can write new test cases and add them to test suites. These cases will typically require review by a Team Leader before being included in official runs.

automation.title: Automation
automation.content: You can use the Automation Studio to record or write automated steps for your test cases, speeding up regression testing.

sidebar.title: Project Setup
sidebar.description: Follow the steps to configure your project with proper documentation.
sidebar.required_info: All fields marked with <required></required> are required. Documents will be saved to your project Wiki.
